action_items.detail: Headless Chromium has no microphone, so the badge stayed on 'Microfone fechado'. Not verified in the UI: the 'Escuta: Deepgram' label, switching to the next engine when one fails, the live transcript starting empty for each block, real speech accuracy, speaker echo and latency. The backend side passed: both engines are available and the tokens do not contain the raw keys.
The 'Falta a chave <motor> no ficheiro backend/.env' message was not tested, because both keys are set and testers must not edit the .env file.
The seed script 'A Espera' has no consecutive lines for any one character, so the block test used its own script tscheck-blk-*.
